title: the proof of the diagram measures the pipeline of the diagrams and the ends of every arrow
intent: The wave that repairs the proof of the track D (the wave D1) for the second time: the check of wave 84 promised more than it proved, and the discriminator of the package of the waves 84 and 86 named two findings that touch it (F18, F21).  The code of the kernel and the pipeline are honest; the proof is not.  The wave touches no code of the kernel and no file of the pipeline.  (1) **The pipeline swallowed a failed generation** (F18): the check ran the subcommand `state-diagram' in a bare tree and waited for the code 3, but nobody ran the **pipeline** `scripts/dev diagrams' there -- and the mutation that made the call of the generator conditional in the pipeline answered 0 and drew the pictures of yesterday, while both checks (84 and 86) stayed green.  The pipeline itself is run in a tree without the kernel now, and the check demands the code 3 **and no picture at all**; the three answers are named apart: the pipeline answered and it is not 3, the pipeline answered 3 and drew pictures, the pipeline drew pictures although the generation failed.  (2) **The check fell with the wrong subject** (F21): the comparison of the cells with the arrows was a comparison of **numbers** and of one added cell, so a generator that reads the table and leads every cell elsewhere passed, and the message said "the generator does not read the table" -- false in both halves: the arrow was there, with ends of its own.  Now **every** cell of the table is compared with its arrow by its ends (`from --> to : label'), the identifier of a state is computed by the check itself (PlantUML does not read a dash in an identifier: `post-decide' becomes `post_decide'), and the three cases are named apart: the cell is not in the diagram (the generator does not read the table), the cell is drawn elsewhere (the generator reads the table but leads the cell elsewhere), the label of the arrow is not the label of the cell.  A guard says that a comparison which did not finish is a failure and not a quiet success.
objection: The claim is about a proof and not about a picture: the check reads the source of the diagram and the code that wrote it, and it never looks at a picture of the site -- the pictures of the site are the waves D3 and D4.  The price is named and it is three prices.  (a) The rule of the identifier of PlantUML is **written twice** -- once in the generator and once in the check -- on purpose, so that a change of the rule by the generator is noticed; the price of the duplication is the duplication.  (b) The pipeline is measured in the case "the tree has no kernel" (the answer 3); another failure of the generation (the generator answers 1) is **not** measured in the pipeline, and the promise "a generation that failed ends the pipeline with its own answer" is closed for the tree without a kernel and not for every failure.  (c) The order of the arrows is not promised and not measured: the comparison goes by the content (a multiset), so a generator that permutes the arrows does not break the check -- the claim promises "every cell is an arrow", not the order of the arrows.
refuted_by: the diagram of the repository is not the file that the generator writes from the current code, or the generator does not read the table of the machine, or the generator does not read the list of the states, or the diagram does not carry every cell and every state of the machine, or an arrow of the diagram carries ends that are not the ends of its cell, or the pipeline does not draw the machine in both themes, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when the machine cannot be generated, or the pipeline draws a picture when the generation of the machine failed, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The claim of the wave is amended and not rewritten: the id `the-state-diagram-comes-from-the-code' is the same, the text says that every cell of the table is an arrow of the diagram **with its own ends**, and that the pipeline in a tree without the kernel answers with the code 3 and draws no picture; the `falsifier' names the new refusals, and the `control' is the same.  Fifteen controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-20 -- ten by the writer of the wave and five more by the parent, and the parent's five were made independently of the report of the writer.  Every one of them ended with the verdict the control asked for.  (1) The honest tree -- the code 0, in 3.9 seconds.  (2) The pipeline skips the generation when the tree has no kernel -- "the pipeline of the diagrams answered 0 in a tree without a kernel and the answer must be 3" and "drew 2 picture(s) ... although the generation failed (the answer was 0)"; code 1.  (3) The same in the other shape -- `( generate_state_diagram ) || true'; the same two texts; code 1.  (4) The generator leads the cell elsewhere -- "the generator reads the table but leads the cell elsewhere: the cell (idle user-prompt deciding) is drawn as (idle --> post_decide : user-prompt)", and the words "does not read the table" are **not** in the answer; code 1.  (5) The control of the claim -- "the diagram of the repository is not the diagram that the code writes: the table of the transitions changed and the diagram was not written again"; code 1.  The measurement of the wave: the table of the machine has thirty-one cells, the diagram has thirty-one arrows (and `[*] --> idle', which is not a cell), and the machine has eleven states; every number is read out of the code and none of them is written into the check.  The comparison goes over every cell twice -- thirty-one cells of the tree of the repository and thirty-two of the copy with the added cell.
